# routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_qos_profile (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the QoS profile.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `automap` (Boolean) Automatically map the packets whose PCP or DSCP value matches the one of this profile to this profile.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `dscp` (Number) IPv4/IPv6 DSCP field value assigned to the egress packets of this QoS profile.
- `pcp` (Number) VLAN priority (IEEE 802.1Q PCP - Priority Code Point) value of this QoS profile.
- `traffic_class` (Number) Traffic class of this QoS profile. It determines the packet priority and the egress queue the packet is placed into.

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) It's the default item.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `hw_id` (Number) The index the profile occupies in the switch chip.
- `hw_offloaded` (Boolean) Whether the profile is programmed into the switch chip.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
